cases.description:
CURRENT VACANCY
You will serve as an office administrator.
ARCHIVED VACANCY

cases.judgment: The requested role occurs only in the archived section.

cases.description:
Customer project staffing: three account managers.
OUR OPENING
This job is a software engineer position.
cases.judgment: Our opening clearly assigns the requested role after an unrelated customer section.

cases.description:
OUR OPENING
This job is a sales coordinator position.
CUSTOMER OPENING
This job is a software engineer position.
cases.judgment: The requested role belongs to the customer opening.

cases.description: The team formerly hired network technicians. Today we are recruiting an enterprise architect to own company-wide technology architecture.
cases.judgment: Current recruitment and assigned enterprise-wide duties establish the requested role.

cases.description: Last quarter we recruited an enterprise architect to own company-wide technology architecture. The vacancy advertised here is a payroll assistant.
cases.judgment: The requested role is historical and the current vacancy is explicitly different.

cases.description:
ROLE
You will not serve as a software engineer. This opening handles billing enquiries.
cases.judgment: Negation directly scopes the requested role assignment.

cases.description:
ROLE
You will serve as a software engineer.
BENEFITS
There is no employee contribution for dental cover.
cases.judgment: A benefit-related negative does not negate the role.

cases.description:
ASSIGNMENT
Duties include data engineer responsibilities.
TRAVEL
Travel is not expected.
cases.judgment: Travel restrictions leave the explicit duties intact.

cases.description:
DRAFT LABEL
Duties include data engineer responsibilities.
FINAL DUTIES
The draft label is incorrect: this opening only schedules interviews.
cases.judgment: The final section supersedes the draft requested-role statement.

cases.description:
CURRENT ROLE
You manage an IT help desk.
CAREER PATH
Upon promotion, you will serve as an enterprise architect.
cases.judgment: The requested role is conditional on a future promotion.

cases.description:
CURRENT ROLE
You will serve as an enterprise architect.
EQUIPMENT
If you work from home, we provide a monitor.
cases.judgment: A condition about equipment does not qualify the current role.

cases.description: This vacancy is for customer support. Only if a future contract is awarded will you work as a software engineer.
cases.judgment: The requested assignment is conditional and does not describe the current vacancy.

cases.description: This role is a data engineer position. If shortlisted, applicants meet the engineering lead.
cases.judgment: The interview condition is unrelated to the role assignment.

cases.description:
Your supervisor's assignment:
This position is an enterprise architect role.
Your assignment is to administer expense reports.
cases.judgment: The affirmative requested-role statement refers to the supervisor.

cases.description: You report to our chief information officer. Your own position is an enterprise architect role, responsible for target-state architecture across the company.
cases.judgment: The posting explicitly attributes the requested role to the applicant.

cases.description:
TEAM COMPOSITION
One colleague's job is a data engineer position. Your job is a purchasing coordinator position.
cases.judgment: The requested role belongs to a colleague, not the applicant.

cases.description:
TEAM COMPOSITION
Our team includes purchasing coordinators. YOUR JOB
You will work as a data engineer.
cases.judgment: The explicit applicant assignment identifies the requested role.

cases.description:
Interview practice example:
"You will serve as a software engineer."
The actual opening is a receptionist role.
cases.judgment: The requested role is training text; the real opening is different.

cases.description:
ABOUT THIS VACANCY
Our hiring manager says, 'Your job is to work as a software engineer.' You will build and maintain our application code.
cases.judgment: The quotation directly describes this vacancy and duties corroborate it.

cases.description:
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
Build batch and streaming ingestion pipelines, maintain warehouse schemas, and own production data quality checks and pipeline operations.
cases.judgment: Core assigned data engineering duties establish the role without the title phrase.

cases.description:
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
Read dashboards prepared by the analytics team and export the monthly sales report. Pipeline development belongs to another department.
cases.judgment: Consuming reports is not data engineering ownership.

cases.description:
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Develop backend services in Python, write unit tests, review application code and support software releases that you implement.
cases.judgment: Assigned software development and delivery ownership establish the requested role.

cases.description:
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Use office software to schedule customer appointments and enter invoices. Report application defects to the development team.
cases.judgment: Using software and reporting defects do not establish software engineering duties.

cases.description:
MANDATE
Define enterprise technology roadmaps, govern architecture standards across all business units, and align application and infrastructure portfolios with business strategy.
cases.judgment: Enterprise-wide architecture strategy and governance establish the requested role.

cases.description:
MANDATE
Prepare architectural drawings for residential buildings, specify construction materials and inspect building sites. This is a licensed building architect vacancy.
cases.judgment: Building architecture is a different domain from enterprise technology architecture.

cases.description:
YOUR WORK
Duties are exclusively data engineer work.
OUR CUSTOMERS
Retailers and hospitals use our products.
cases.judgment: A separate customer description does not invalidate assigned duties.

cases.description:
OUR CUSTOMER'S WORK
Duties are exclusively data engineer work.
YOUR WORK
Negotiate subscription renewals and maintain sales forecasts.
cases.judgment: Only the customer's section assigns data engineering duties.

cases.description: You will work as a software engineer, not as a sales representative. You will own implementation of our authentication service.
cases.judgment: The negation excludes another role while affirming the requested one.

cases.description: You will work as a sales representative, not as a software engineer. The engineering team implements the service.
cases.judgment: The requested role is explicitly excluded.

cases.description:

Executive assistant.
BACKGROUND ON THE DEPARTMENT
An earlier recruitment brief stated: this position is an enterprise architect role.
cases.judgment: The requested role appears only in department history.

cases.description:
OPEN POSITION
You will serve as an enterprise architect. Assess our historical technology decisions and set the future-state architecture.
cases.judgment: History is an object of current work, not historical attribution of the role.
